acceptedSignals.statement: Later evidence must re-check that each digest-bound source output is still present and unchanged.
acceptedSignals.cheapestTest: Remove, alter, and summary-replace registered outputs, then require MISSING or CHANGED instead of CURRENT.
acceptedSignals.uncertainty: Filesystem race behavior outside the focused source verifier remains bounded but not universally proven.
solutionAlternatives: Use the existing Evidence Retention closure repair instead of importing another output-bundle authority.

acceptedSignals.statement: A simulation run needs one exact portable baseline identity across software, Mirror, and specialist-mask subjects.
acceptedSignals.cheapestTest: Build and verify one capsule per subject kind, then compare unchanged, changed, new-information, and incomparable cases.
acceptedSignals.uncertainty: Live private Mirror and specialist host-model effectiveness remain unobserved.
solutionAlternatives: Use Git and subject-native identity independently without a portable adapter.

acceptedSignals.statement: Need, gap, provenance, candidate, verification, human decision, availability, and refresh should remain linked in one exact receipt chain.
acceptedSignals.cheapestTest: Build a capability cycle through each state and reject altered digests, non-human decisions, and self-certified availability.
acceptedSignals.uncertainty: A linked receipt does not prove the underlying capability helps a person or AI workflow.
solutionAlternatives: Keep separate native receipts and require manual cross-reference review.

acceptedSignals.statement: Structural claims may use machine-readable state, while appearance, layout, spatial, motion, and interaction claims still require native live visual evidence.
acceptedSignals.cheapestTest: Route a visual claim to schema inspection and require an evidence-surface mismatch hold.
acceptedSignals.uncertainty: Performance and concurrency benefit from semantic-first operation is not measured.
solutionAlternatives: Always capture visuals, accepting higher cost and privacy exposure.

acceptedSignals.statement: Reversible signal links may improve human review comprehension, but the effect requires voluntary human-native evidence.
acceptedSignals.cheapestTest: Run an opt-in representative review with and without links, preserving completion, withdrawal, errors, time, dissent, and free-text judgment.
acceptedSignals.uncertainty: No human comparison was run, so benefit and maintenance cost remain unknown.
solutionAlternatives: Wait for voluntary evidence and keep current review surfaces unchanged.

acceptedSignals.statement: An unchanged exact baseline with no new evidence, counterexample, requirement, failure, or signal should stop rather than recursively generate agreement.
acceptedSignals.cheapestTest: Repeat the exact baseline with an empty new-information set and assert NO_NEW_INFORMATION plus zero generation work.
acceptedSignals.uncertainty: A stop rule cannot discover information that was never declared or observed.
solutionAlternatives: Use a human-scheduled refresh with an explicit new-information receipt.

rejectedOrDeferred.reason: No capability gap requires an autonomous recursive model service; it conflicts with bounded budgets and human authority.
Agreement is corroboration only and cannot replace the claim-native verifier.
The Workshop already has local evidence and lineage organs; a global score would erase claim types, uncertainty, and dissent.
Candidates cannot execute, install, grant permission, promote, merge, or canonize themselves.
Evidence Desk, Evidence Retention, Evidence Router, Verification Spine, and Visual Proof already cover the needed native routes.
Human usefulness remains unmeasured; no ledger should be added merely because models proposed one.
